description:
Overview 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 At Microsoft Security, we are committed to making the world a safer place by developing an end-to-end security cloud that simplifies and strengthens our customers' security postures. With ever-increasing threats, regulatory requirements, and estate complexity, organizations face daunting challenges managing and securing vast amounts of data across on-premises, multi-cloud, and SaaS environments. Our team is building a high-scale, exabyte-scale data platform to help enterprises: Inventory and map their entire digital estate: From devices and users to permissions, data systems, and virtual machines, we help organizations discover and gain visibility into every asset. Integrate and normalize data: By pre-integrating security data from disparate sources and standardizing it, we empower customers to store, retain, and use security logs more efficiently and affordably. Answer critical security and governance questions: From identifying what systems exist and what's in them, to ensuring compliance with legal and corporate policies, we provide customers with insights and control over their security landscape. By leveraging an advanced security graph, built using AI and machine learning algorithms, we enable organizations to detect patterns, uncover threats, and make informed decisions about their digital estate's security posture in real time. As a Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and deploying this exabyte-scale platform that can process data across billions of streams, files, tables, and reports. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in a highly collaborative environment, delivering a solution that makes security management accessible and actionable for organizations of all sizes.



 Responsibilities 
 Designs and implements large-scale data pipelines and services to support security data ingestion, normalization, and storage.
 Collaborates with cross-functional teams including product management, security experts, and data scientists to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
 Optimizes platform performance to handle vast amounts of data across diverse digital systems while ensuring scalability, availability, and security.
 Works on cloud-native technologies and distributed systems to build a robust, resilient, and secure platform.
 Continuously improves the platform by leveraging new technologies and best practices in security, data governance, and cloud infrastructure. 
 

 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience
 Other Requirements 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience
 
 Experience building scalable, distributed systems or data platforms, and an interest in learning how large-scale systems handle high data volumes and throughput
 Experience with data processing, ETL, or data pipeline development, including building connectors that bring data from multiple sources to downstream destinations
 Experience with or exposure to security data and detection solutions such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, or NDR, or with logging and monitoring platforms
 Familiarity with cloud platforms and with cloud-native architecture, microservices, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
 Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in applying AI to solve engineering problems
 Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous problems, understand the business context, and drive toward high-quality solutions
 

 Software Engineering IC2 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $85,400 - $168,100 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $111,100 - $183,700 per year.
